name: LASt Missing
summary:
a prequel to My Fiancé is a Fiend
✦ a spooktober 2026 horror visual novel ✦
An invitation to a party in a mansion on the edge of town. The man in the yellow mask is already waiting on the porch. Something in the dark is waiting with him. The evening starts, ends, and starts again.

The host in the yellow robe won't leave you alone for a second. And in the dark corner of the hall, someone sits perfectly still and doesn't take their eyes off you.

How many times will you have to live through this evening before it lets you go?
